key_insight: Training on structured experimental evidence enabled OpenPerov to reason about perovskite solar cells and select a contact material that outperformed the expert-preferred alternative.
engineering_relevance: Evidence-grounded AI could guide contact-material selection and experimental design to improve solar-cell efficiency and thermal stability.
method: Reconstructed expert-calibrated evidence records from 4,035 articles, linking strategies, controls and observations to mechanisms.
Adapted OpenPerov using structured evidence; added retrieval-based passage revision in OpenPerov Pro.
Evaluated scientific reasoning and experimentally tested K- versus Na-analogue self-assembled monolayer contacts.
evidence_signal: On the 800-question PSM-Bench, OpenPerov Flash ranked first among 13 closed-book systems; devices using the selected contact reached 27.05% efficiency and retained 96.74% after 1,000 h of dark thermal ageing at 85 °C.
watch_item: The reported contact-design test does not establish broad materials generalization, scalable manufacturing or stability under illuminated operating conditions.
paper_title: Evidence-grounded large language models guide perovskite solar cell design and optimization
